segments.name: Homebuying Services
segments.description: Provides residential real estate brokerage, mortgage brokering and title and escrow services to homebuyers through the reAlpha platform.
segments.evidence: Accordingly, the Company has concluded that it has two reportable segments: Homebuying Services and Technology Services.

segments.name: Technology Services
products: AI conversational customer experience solutions platform
segments.description: Provides AI conversational customer platforms to businesses and software development and tech support services to third parties.
segments.evidence: Our technology services segment includes: (i) software development services provided by reAlpha Nepal to us and third parties and (ii) the AI-powered conversational platform provided to customers by AiChat.

revenueModel.text: Technology customers pay subscriptions and consulting fees for the AiChat platform; homebuying revenue comes from brokerage commissions on real estate and mortgage transactions.
revenueModel.evidence: AiChat generates revenue from its AI conversational customer experience solutions platform, which includes subscription-based platform access and related consulting services.

changes.text: The short-term rental business was discontinued in 2025 and reported as discontinued operations.
changes.evidence: As a result, in the first quarter of 2025, our board of directors (the "Board") approved the discontinuation of our short-term rental business operations entirely and this discontinuation meets the criteria for being reported as discontinued operations.
